nodes.description: Registry contract reference used by LendingPool to fetch core, dataProvider, parametersProvider and feeProvider.
LendingPoolCore instance that holds all deposited funds and reserve state.
LendingPoolDataProvider used to compute user global balances, LTV and health factor.
LendingPoolParametersProvider supplying protocol parameters such as flashloan fees.
IFeeProvider used to compute loan origination fees.
Owner address controlling onlyOwner-protected upgrade/admin functions.
Address of the authorized LendingPool; gates all onlyLendingPool state mutators and fund transfers.
Mapping of component keys to registered addresses inside LendingPoolAddressesProvider.
Underlying reserve asset bound to the aToken, used for interest and transfer checks.
Mutex counter implementing the nonReentrant modifier.
Tracks the last initialized revision to prevent re-initialization of proxies.
External payable entrypoint to deposit a reserve asset, mint aTokens and update core state.
Overlying aToken-triggered redeem that updates core state and transfers the underlying asset to the user.
Borrow entrypoint validating collateral, fees and rate mode then transferring funds to msg.sender.
Repay entrypoint performing payback arithmetic and fund transfers to reserve/fee address.
Swaps a user borrow position between stable and variable rate modes.
Rebalances a user stable rate; deprecated for the V1 to V2 migration.
Enables or disables a user deposit as collateral after an allowed-balance-decrease check.
Liquidates an undercollateralized position via a delegatecall into the liquidation manager.
Provides flashloans, calls back into the receiver and verifies the returned liquidity plus fee.
Proxy initializer wiring the LendingPool to the addresses provider components.
onlyLendingPool transfer of ERC20 or ETH to a user; ETH path performs a low-level call.
onlyLendingPool transfer from user to reserve handling ERC20 and ETH (including excess refund) paths.
onlyLendingPool transfer of fees to the fee collector; ETH path performs a low-level call.
onlyLendingPool liquidation fee transfer; ETH path performs a low-level call.
Updates reserve and user borrow state, compounding interest indices and rate mode.
Updates reserve and user state after a repay, adjusting total borrows and principal.
Updates principal reserve, collateral reserve and liquidated user state after liquidation.
Distributes flashloan protocol fee and cumulates the received income to the liquidity index.
Redeems aTokens for the underlying asset; cumulates balance then calls pool.redeemUnderlying.
OnlyLendingPool mint of aTokens on deposit and update of redirected balances.
OnlyLendingPool burn of aTokens on liquidation.
OnlyLendingPool transfer of aTokens on liquidation.
Internal ERC20 transfer overridden to validate the transfer via balanceDecreaseAllowed.
Internal registry update that deploys or upgrades InitializableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy instances.
onlyOwner setter updating the lending pool implementation address.
onlyOwner transfer of contract ownership.
onlyOwner renunciation of ownership.
Performs a low-level call to an ERC20 token and optionally decodes a boolean return.
ifAdmin upgrade of the implementation followed by a delegatecall with init data.
Assembly delegatecall forwarding msg.data to the implementation contract.
Initializes logic, admin and init data for the proxy; guarded by implementation zero-check.
Computes linear interest using block.timestamp and the last update timestamp.
Computes compounded interest via rayPow using block.timestamp delta.
Checks whether a balance decrease keeps the user health factor above the liquidation threshold.
onlyLendingPool update of reserve state on deposit, enabling collateral on first deposit.
Caller-controlled address used across entrypoints for authorization and fund routing.
Block timestamp used for interest accrual and event emission; miner-influenced.
Raw delegatecall forwarding arbitrary calldata to the implementation address.
delegatecall into the liquidation manager address fetched from the registry.
Low-level ETH call to _user inside transferToUser with a 50000 gas limit.
Low-level ETH call to the fee address with a 50000 gas limit.
Low-level ETH call to the fee address during fee liquidation.
Low-level ETH call refunding excess msg.value to the user.
Low-level call into an arbitrary ERC20 token address with optional return decoding.
External callback into the flashloan receiver contract during flashLoan.
delegatecall of arbitrary data into the new implementation during proxy upgrade.
delegatecall of init data into the logic contract during proxy initialization.
_reserve parameter of LendingPool.deposit.
_amount parameter of LendingPool.deposit.
_referralCode parameter of LendingPool.deposit.
_receiver parameter of LendingPool.flashLoan; arbitrary receiver contract.
_params parameter of LendingPool.flashLoan forwarded to the receiver.
_user parameter of LendingPool.liquidationCall (borrower being liquidated).
_collateral parameter of LendingPool.liquidationCall.
_purchaseAmount parameter of LendingPool.liquidationCall.
_receiveAToken parameter of LendingPool.liquidationCall.
amountFee computed in flashLoan from the amount and total fee basis points.
availableLiquidityBefore snapshot used to validate the returned flashloan amount.
BorrowLocalVars memory struct holding borrow computation temporaries.
paybackAmount computed in repay from compounded borrow balance and fee.

edges.reason: msg.sender selects the depositor and aToken recipient in deposit.
msg.sender is the borrower whose collateral data is checked in borrow.
msg.sender is used for the on-behalf-of repayment authorization in repay.
msg.sender acts as the liquidator passed into the delegatecall in liquidationCall.
msg.sender context is used during flashloan validation and transfers.
owner check via msg.sender gates the implementation setter.
ownership transfer is authorized against msg.sender.
block.timestamp is embedded in the Deposit event (timestamp dependency).
block.timestamp is embedded in the Borrow event (timestamp dependency).
linear interest accrual depends on block.timestamp.
compounded interest accrual depends on block.timestamp.
user lastUpdateTimestamp is written from block.timestamp in borrow state update.
deposit reads core to resolve the reserve aToken address.
deposit transfers funds into the reserve through the core ETH/ERC20 transfer path.
deposit calls aToken.mintOnDeposit to mint the corresponding aTokens.
deposit updates reserve state via core.updateStateOnDeposit.
redeemUnderlying queries available liquidity from the core.
redeemUnderlying transfers the underlying asset out to the user via the core.
AToken.redeem triggers pool.redeemUnderlying which performs the asset transfer.
borrow reads aggregated user global data from the data provider.
borrow updates borrow state performing interest and principal arithmetic in the core.
borrow transfers the borrowed amount to the user via the core.
repay updates borrow state with subtraction arithmetic on principal and fees.
repay moves the repaid amount into the reserve via the core transfer.
liquidationCall reaches the delegatecall into the liquidation manager.
liquidationCall fetches the liquidation manager from the addresses provider.
liquidation path updates reserve and user state with borrow arithmetic.
flashLoan calls back into the arbitrary receiver contract before settlement.
flashLoan transfers the borrowed liquidity to the receiver via the core.
flashLoan finalizes state via core.updateStateOnFlashLoan.
transferToUser performs a low-level ETH call to the user.
transferToReserve refunds excess ETH via a low-level call to the user.
transferToFeeCollectionAddress performs a low-level ETH call to the fee address.
liquidateFee performs a low-level ETH call to the fee address.
ERC20 path of transferToUser uses SafeERC20.safeTransfer which delegates to callOptionalReturn.
callOptionalReturn executes a low-level call into an arbitrary token.
Proxy._delegate performs the raw delegatecall forwarding calldata.
upgradeToAndCall delegatecalls the supplied data into the new implementation.
updateImplInternal initializes a newly created InitializableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy.
updateImplInternal upgrades an existing proxy via upgradeToAndCall.
borrow state update compounds indices using calculateLinearInterest.
borrow state update compounds indices using calculateCompoundedInterest.
onlyOwner modifier reads _owner before transferOwnership executes.
onlyOwner modifier reads _owner before renounceOwnership executes.
onlyOwner modifier on setLendingPoolImpl is validated against _owner.
onlyLendingPool gate on transferToUser checks lendingPoolAddress.
onlyLendingPool gate on transferToReserve checks lendingPoolAddress.
onlyLendingPool gate on transferToFeeCollectionAddress checks lendingPoolAddress.
onlyLendingPool gate on liquidateFee checks lendingPoolAddress.
onlyLendingPool gate on updateStateOnBorrow checks lendingPoolAddress.
nonReentrant modifier on deposit reads and writes _guardCounter.
nonReentrant modifier on flashLoan reads and writes _guardCounter.
transferOnLiquidation ultimately executes the overridden _transfer.
_reserve parameter feeds deposit reserve resolution.
_amount parameter feeds deposit amount handling.
_referralCode parameter is emitted in the Deposit event.
_receiver parameter determines the flashloan callback target.
_params parameter is forwarded to the flashloan receiver.
_user parameter is forwarded into the liquidation delegatecall.
_collateral parameter is forwarded into the liquidation delegatecall.
_purchaseAmount parameter is forwarded into the liquidation delegatecall.
_receiveAToken parameter is forwarded into the liquidation delegatecall.
amountFee is derived by multiplication/division from the requested amount and fee bips.
availableLiquidityBefore is compared against post-callback liquidity in flashLoan.
BorrowLocalVars carries the borrow computation temporaries.
paybackAmount is computed from compounded borrow balance plus origination fee.
